{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove rows with '999,999.99' in revenue
filtered_df = df[df['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Verify the removal
print(f"Number of rows with '999,999.99' after filtering: {len(filtered_df[filtered_df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'])}")

# Confirm the dataset is clean
print(f"Final cleaned dataset shape: {filtered_df.shape}")

# Check the value counts of 'revenue' again to ensure no QA rows remain
print("Value counts of 'revenue':")
print(filtered_df['revenue'].value_counts().head(10))"}
